task_name: World 102 Task B  -  Unstarted Roof Deposit Liability & AR Collection Credited to Revenue
prompt: Audit the QBO revenue anomalies in `buildops_vs_qbo_margin_bridge_2026_Q3.xlsx` (`QBO_Revenue_Ledger_Anomalies` and `Subledger_vs_QBO_Summary`). Reconcile QBO Recognized Revenue to BuildOps earned revenue, diagnose every anomalous deposit or receivable collection row in the revenue ledger, and provide the exact correcting journal entries and adjusted Gross Margin.

rubric.description: Reports the raw revenue variance between QBO Recognized Revenue ($1,503,400.00) and BuildOps earned revenue ($1,420,000.00) as $83,400.00.
Identifies DEP-401 ($55,000.00 from Oakridge HOA Claim #88) as an unstarted roof replacement deposit (0% complete as of Sep 30, tear-off in Nov 2026) improperly credited to 4000 Roofing Revenue.
Proposes reclassifying DEP-401 by debiting 4000 Roofing Revenue $55,000.00 and crediting 2400 Customer Deposits / Unearned Revenue $55,000.00.

Identifies DEP-418 ($28,400.00 from Vance Commercial Properties) as a collection of prior-month Invoice #INV-1088 that was credited directly to 4000 Roofing Revenue instead of clearing 1100 Accounts Receivable.
Proposes correcting DEP-418 by debiting 4000 Roofing Revenue $28,400.00 and crediting 1100 Accounts Receivable $28,400.00 (`receivable_collection_credited_to_income`).
Verifies that removing DEP-401 ($55,000.00) and DEP-418 ($28,400.00) reduces QBO Revenue by $83,400.00 to $1,420,000.00, tying 100% to BuildOps earned revenue ($0.00 variance).
Computes adjusted QBO Gross Profit after both revenue corrections ($1,420,000.00) and the $82,300.00 Q4 inventory reclass (COGS $907,300.00) as $512,700.00.
Computes adjusted QBO Gross Margin (%) after the revenue and inventory corrections as 36.11% ($512,700.00 / $1,420,000.00).

gold_output:
World 102 Task B  -  Unstarted Roof Deposit & AR Collection Credited to Revenue Audit:
1. Raw Revenue Variance: QBO Recognized Revenue ($1,503,400.00) exceeds BuildOps earned revenue ($1,420,000.00) by $83,400.00.
2. Unstarted Roof Deposit (DEP-401): $55,000.00 from Oakridge HOA Claim #88 is a 50% insurance deposit for an unstarted roof replacement (0% complete as of Sep 30; tear-off scheduled Nov 2026) improperly credited to 4000 Roofing Revenue. Correcting JE: Dr 4000 Roofing Revenue $55,000.00 / Cr 2400 Customer Deposits / Unearned Revenue $55,000.00.
3. AR Collection Credited to Revenue (DEP-418): $28,400.00 from Vance Commercial Properties is a check collecting prior-month Invoice #INV-1088 that was credited directly to 4000 Roofing Revenue instead of clearing 1100 Accounts Receivable (`receivable_collection_credited_to_income`). Correcting JE: Dr 4000 Roofing Revenue $28,400.00 / Cr 1100 Accounts Receivable $28,400.00.
4. Reconciled Revenue & Gross Margin: Removing DEP-401 ($55,000.00) and DEP-418 ($28,400.00) reduces QBO Revenue by $83,400.00 to $1,420,000.00, tying 100% to BuildOps earned revenue ($0.00 variance). With adjusted COGS of $907,300.00 (after the $82,300.00 warehouse inventory reclass), adjusted QBO Gross Profit is $512,700.00 and adjusted Gross Margin is 36.11%.
